fees.deliveryFit: Good. You set your own delivery profile (free to England, Scotland, Wales; £90 to Northern Ireland and islands) and your own processing time, so own-team 2-person delivery works. Keep proof of delivery (signature or photo) for any dispute.
fees.handmadeFit: Very good. Etsy's Creativity Standards allow items made by the seller and shop members with hand and power tools; furniture made in your own workshop fits. Shop members must be described in the shop's About section.
fees.payout: New sellers: funds usually available 14 days after a sale, paid weekly on Mondays by default; a reserve can apply to new shops (https://help.etsy.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002080688-Why-Hasn-t-My-Money-Been-Deposited-Yet, accessed 2026-11-10).
risks: Smaller bed audience than Amazon; buyers come for unique/handmade looks
Offsite Ads at 15% if not opted out
Photos must show the real item; several current photos look computer-generated
New-shop payment reserve can hold cash

feeLines.fee: Referral fee 12.24% per sale (no other selling fee)
Professional plan £25/month (excl. VAT) waived once approved for Handmade

fees.deliveryFit: Workable but strict. Seller-fulfilled: Amazon requires at least 90% on-time delivery (OTDR, from 16 Sep 2025); the new accurate-handling-time rule (29 Jun 2026) does not apply to custom and handmade items. Your van team gives no carrier tracking number, so ask Seller Support how to confirm own-fleet deliveries before you list. Heavy & Bulky programme (>30 kg or >1.5 m) is invite-only.
fees.handmadeFit: Good, subject to approval. Products must be handmade, hand-altered or hand-assembled; mass-produced items are not allowed; third-party guides quote a limit of 20 or fewer employees (owner must confirm headcount and check Amazon's own policy page). Application is reviewed manually.
fees.payout: Funds released 7 days after delivery date (DD+7) as standard; Amazon can set a longer reserve for new accounts (Amazon staff post: https://sellercentral.amazon.co.uk/seller-forums/discussions/t/a3106511f780c0ef74b7d8e2360163f7, accessed 2026-11-10).
risks: Approval needed and can take time
On-time delivery and tracking metrics can suspend listings
Amazon's own return rules apply on top of ours
DD+7 payout delay
Main image needs a plain white background

recommendation.order: Open Etsy first (this week), then apply to Amazon Handmade in parallel. Leave eBay for a later test of the ottoman and divan bases. Skip OnBuy and ManoMano for now.
reasons: Etsy has the lowest cost on a £400 bed (about £44 before VAT, no monthly fee), is built for handmade sellers, and lets us set our own delivery and making time.

Amazon Handmade has the biggest UK buyer audience, the monthly fee is waived once approved, and 12.24% is a flat fee (about £49 on £400). It is the only Amazon route with a handmade badge and no barcodes needed.
eBay costs about the same as Amazon Handmade but shows us next to cheap imported ottoman beds with no handmade badge.
OnBuy (15% + £25/month) and ManoMano (15–25% + £50/month) cost more and their buyers are not looking for handmade beds.
